item.title: Business Meeting
item.description: We will discuss any pressing business for the conference, cover the financials and operations of QEC26, and announce the hosts for QEC27. All are welcome to attend!

item.title: Closing Remarks
item.description: Goodbye, folks! See you next year!

item.title: Conference Dinner
item.description: The Conference Dinner this year will take place in the Plaza del Sol at the Hilton Beachfront Santa Barbara after the Business Meeting. We will also have a speaker for the dinner, more information coming soon!

item.title: Gala Dinner and Networking at Pazo los Escudos Hotel
item.description: The Gala Dinner this year will take place at Pazo Los Escudos. Please don’t worry about the distance from the city center, as a series of buses will transport us there and back. The buses will depart at 19:30 from the location indicated below.

item.title: Lab Tour and Excursion to Cíes Islands (click for more details)
item.description: The afternoon of wednesday will consist of two possible afternoon activities. LAB TOUR If you signed up for the lab tour, the bus will depart from the location indicated below (Rua Areal, towards the intersection with Rua Colón). The bus will leave at 15:30 and the trip to the lab will take 25 minutes. Once the lab tour is finished, the bus will bring us back to the city center.

item.title: Public Lecture: 'Ordenadores y criptografía cuántica: ¿qué pasa cuando los bits se vuelven cuánticos?' 'Quantum computers and cryptography: what happens when bits become quantum?'
item.description: On Monday evening at 7:00 PM, Professor Antonio Acín will give a public lecture titled ‘‘Ordenadores y criptografía cuántica: ¿qué pasa cuando los bits se vuelven cuánticos?’’ (‘‘Quantum Computers and Cryptography: What Happens When Bits Become Quantum?’’). The lecture is open to everyone, including conference participants and the general public! The event will take place at the García Barbón Theatre, just a few meters from the conference venue. (The location of the theatre is provided below.

item.title: Registration
item.description: Registration will be at the Hilton, near the entrance to the Grand Ballroom.

item.title: Registration & Coffee
item.description: Registration & Coffee in the OIST conference center, entrance hall.

item.title: Welcome Reception at Palacio de la Oliva (click for more details)
item.description: QCrypt welcomes you to Vigo with this special event included in your registration! Join us at the Palacio de La Oliva for an aperitif with fellow participants. The venue for the welcome reception is just a 10-minute walk from the conference site, situated in the heart of Vigo’s old town. (Location details are provided below.)
